sections.title: Song time
sections.text:
Reduce, reuse and recycle
Do not go to school by car every day. Take a bus, take the subway, or walk if you may. It’s a great way to reduce.
Do not throw the old toys away. Give them to little kids to play with. It’s a great way to reuse.
Do not use a plastic bag day after day. A cloth bag or a paper one is also okay. It’s a great way to recycle.
Reduce, reuse and recycle to make our life greener every day.

sections.title: Talking time
sections.text:
Boys and girls, what can we do to live a greener life?
I turn off the tap when I brush my teeth.
Good boy! Every time we do this, we save water.
I use both sides of the paper.
Good. You see, paper is made from wood. Use less paper and we can save a lot of trees.
I remind my mum to unplug the TV from the wall.
Right. Always unplug your TV after watching. It is a good way to save energy.
I like walking to school every day. It is a good way to reduce air pollution.
Yes, and it’s a healthy habit too.
I plant seeds and watch them grow.
Good idea. Plants help keep the air clean and fresh.
Find the rule: It is a good way to save energy. It is a good way to recycle. It is a good way to reduce air pollution.

sections.title: Story time
sections.text:
Baggie’s new life
Baggie is a plastic bag. Someone drops it into the sea. Baggie is very sad.
Suddenly, a big whale swims by and eats it up. ‘Oh, no, it’s not a jellyfish and it can make me ill.’ The whale sneezes and opens his mouth wide. Baggie comes out quickly.
A moment later, a sea turtle spots Baggie and swallows it. ‘Oh, no, it’s not a jellyfish and it can make me very ill.’ The turtle coughs hard and Baggie comes out all at once.
A big wave carries Baggie to the beach.
Before long, a boy comes by. ‘Plastic bags should not lie around,’ the boy says. He picks Baggie up and makes it into a kite.
Now Baggie is happy, ‘Wow, I’m flying and I’m useful again!’

Our greener life booklet
I usually get gifts on my birthday. I don’t throw the gift boxes away. I can collect them and make a toy robot with them. It’s a good way to save trees.
Choose a page. Choose and write. Decorate your page. Work with your teammates and put your pages together.
